task_type: supplier geography ingestion and zero-inventory search recovery
goal: Import the complete supplier geography hierarchy independently of inventory, expose every destination in vacation and event search, and recover nearby inventory without indexing unapproved thin pages.

applicable_lessons.title: Completion requires regression and production evidence
Shared changes expand to the affected family
Indexation requires editorial quality and explicit approval
Supplier truth and local editorial overrides stay distinct

requirements.statement: All supplier districts, areas and cities are searchable even without inventory, with nearby recovery and editorially gated sitemap publication.
requirements.acceptance_check: The exact production release imports multiple hierarchy levels, contains Yashresh, returns nearby vacation and event inventory, and does not index an unapproved Yashresh page.
evidence: Commit 5bc6022 is pushed to origin/review/vii-api-refresh-20261008 and submitted once to the established VII publisher.

requirements.statement: Predict rejection reasons and bind prevention to observable evidence.
requirements.acceptance_check: The task preflight and acceptance contracts validate before implementation.
evidence: Both bounded preflight and acceptance validators passed before implementation.

requirements.statement: Verify compound identity, unassigned handling, distance ordering and indexation gating before broad verification.
requirements.acceptance_check: Focused tests cover level-scoped IDs, area_id zero, coordinates, deterministic proximity and publication gating.
evidence: 12/12 focused geography tests and 39/39 relevant geography, search, URL, editorial and sitemap tests passed.

requirements.statement: Attempt to disprove completion in the exact production release.
requirements.acceptance_check: Verify hierarchy counts, Yashresh autocomplete and nearby recovery in both worlds, and absence from sitemap before approval.

requirements.statement: Measure whether the preflight prevented known geography and SEO failures.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record first-pass state, repeated corrections, prevented failures and elapsed time.

evidence: The parser no longer manufactures area:0 and accepts root object-keyed hierarchy nodes.
Nearby recovery is bounded to 100 km and stable by distance then business identity.
findings: The production importer previously parsed only root.unassigned, which explained the single Bayt Lid node.
